candidates.source_name: Shoptet Doplňky – kategorie Platby (payment add-on marketplace)
candidates.why_relevant: Shoptet is the dominant CZ e-shop platform (tens of thousands of merchants). Its Platby add-on category is a live, enumerable registry of which payment gateways/PSPs are actually integrated and sold to Czech merchants (Comgate, GoPay, Pays, GP webpay, Shoptet Pay, ThePay, BNPL, insurance). Listing pages carry install/rating signals and vendor descriptions, making it the cleanest buy-side adoption proxy in CZ e-commerce.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Periodic HTML crawl of the category index + each add-on detail page; diff vendor list and ratings over time to detect new entrants and churn.
candidates.discovered_via_method: cs-language search on platform plugin marketplaces
queries_used: Shoptet platební brána doplňky seznam poskytovatelů

candidates.source_name: Shoptet Blog – Platební metody a platební brány (annual overview)
candidates.why_relevant: Vendor-neutral-ish annual roundup written for merchants, comparing CZ gateways, pricing models and feature sets; useful for tracking which providers the platform itself promotes and how the competitive set shifts year over year.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Fetch article + follow yearly re-publications; extract provider names and stated fee ranges.
queries_used: Shoptet platební brána doplňky seznam poskytovatelů

candidates.source_name: Kancelář finančního arbitra – Sbírka rozhodnutí (decisions collection)
candidates.why_relevant: The Czech financial ombudsman publishes anonymised nálezy/rozhodnutí naming the payment service provider complained against. These are the only public, adjudicated records of failing payment implementations (unauthorised transactions, SCA failures, card/gateway disputes) and directly expose vendor and bank weaknesses.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scrape decision index (type, sp. zn., date, respondent firm), download PDFs, index by respondent institution and dispute type; complement with s.106/1999 info requests for unpublished decisions.
queries_used: finanční arbitr nález platební služba sbírka rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: Kancelář finančního arbitra – Platební služby area page + annual reports
candidates.why_relevant: Scope/jurisdiction page and gateway to annual reports (výroční zprávy) which aggregate complaint counts by institution and dispute type — a quantitative buy-side complaint signal.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Annual PDF pull; extract complaint tables by institution.
queries_used: finanční arbitr nález platební služba sbírka rozhodnutí

candidates.source_name: Alza.cz newsroom – Adyen partnership announcement
candidates.why_relevant: Primary confirmation that the largest Czech e-tailer switched its online AND in-store terminal acquiring to Adyen, unifying providers across all countries it operates in. This is exactly the buy-side switch signal the cell targets, and implies displacement of an incumbent CZ acquirer.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Monitor Alza newsroom/press pages and the mirrored Adyen knowledge-hub case study; alert on PSP/acquirer keywords.
queries_used: Alza.cz platební metody Rohlík Notino platební brána poskytovatel

candidates.source_name: Merchant checkout / payment-options help pages (Alza, Rohlík, Notino, Košík)
candidates.why_relevant: Public 'možnosti platby' pages enumerate accepted methods and frequently name the gateway/bank buttons (Platba 24, eKonto Online, MojePlatba, Apple/Google Pay, BNPL partners). Diffed over time they reveal PSP switches before any press release. Alza's corporate-card surcharge page also shows merchant reaction to interchange/commercial-card fees.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Scheduled snapshot + text diff of each merchant's payment-options page; separately inspect checkout page network domains for PSP fingerprints (respecting robots/ToS).
queries_used: Alza.cz platební metody Rohlík Notino platební brána poskytovatel

candidates.source_name: Cvak A2A payment rollout coverage (Albert, Lidl) – Měšec.cz / HN / Deník
candidates.why_relevant: Highest-value current buy-side signal: major grocery chains (Albert first, then Lidl CZ across ~326 stores) adopting Cvak account-to-account payments — backed notably by Air Bank, with Fio, mBank and Moneta clients supported — explicitly to cut card-scheme fees and as a fallback during card outages. Direct evidence of card-rail disintermediation driven by merchant economics.
candidates.suggested_collection_method: Keyword monitor 'Cvak', 'platba z účtu na účet', 'A2A' across mesec.cz, penize.cz, hn.cz, denik.cz; snowball to the Cvak operator's own site and bank release notes.

Contains named complaints such as 'Nefunkční platební brána a mnohonásobné stržení částky z účtu' — i.e. concrete failing gateway implementations, duplicate captures, refund failures, per merchant, with merchant responses. negative_findings.description: No Czech-specific Downdetector-equivalent outage archive with historical, queryable data was located. Searches surfaced only journalistic write-ups of outages (Deník, Peníze.cz, aRecenze) rather than a structured status/outage dataset for CZ banks, gateways or card schemes.
negative_findings.result_summary: Downdetector CZ country pages were not confirmed in results; outage evidence is currently only narrative press coverage plus, presumably, individual bank status pages not yet enumerated.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Outage frequency/duration per institution is one of the strongest demand-side quality signals for this cell; without a structured feed the workstream must reconstruct timelines from press, which is slower and biased toward large incidents.

negative_findings.description: Public operator pages for DPP/PID contactless fare payment describe terminal counts and the DOS/XT-Card carrier ecosystem but do not name the acquirer, terminal supplier or payment processor behind the open-loop card acceptance.
negative_findings.result_summary: Search explicitly returned that no concrete supplier for the in-vehicle contactless acceptance was identified in operator or PID materials.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Vendor attribution for the flagship CZ transit deployment is missing, so acquirer/terminal-vendor market-share inference in transport is currently unsupported from buy-side sources alone.

negative_findings.description: APEK's flagship E-commerce Study (payment-method mix) is free only to association members; non-members face a purchase barrier.
negative_findings.result_summary: APEK announcement page states the 2025 study is free for members; full datasets are not openly downloadable.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: The best quantitative payment-mix time series for CZ e-commerce cannot be collected by crawling and needs a licensing/membership decision.

negative_findings.description: Merchant-side disclosure for Notino and Košík of their payment providers was not found; only Alza (Adyen) and Rohlík (Adyen listed among online-payment services, plus crypto work with Confirmo) yielded provider-level evidence in this pass.
negative_findings.result_summary: Searches on Notino/Košík payment providers returned no primary or trade-press provider attribution.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Leaves gaps in the top-merchant PSP map that this cell is supposed to build; requires checkout-level technical fingerprinting or subprocessor/privacy-policy inspection instead of search.

negative_findings.description: For consumer outage-tracking platforms there is no established Czech-language term or local service; searches had to rely on the English brand 'Downdetector' plus cs terms 'výpadek'/'nedostupnost'.
negative_findings.result_summary: cs terms 'výpadek', 'odstávka', 'nedostupnost' work for press coverage but no local crowd-outage platform exists in results.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Documents that local-language coverage for this sub-topic is inherently limited, not an omission by the scout.

coverage_gaps.description: Heureka.cz merchant/product reviews and Reddit (r/czech, r/Prague, r/czechrepublic) were not yet mined for payment-failure and gateway-complaint threads in this pass.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Run dedicated cs and en searches and, where permitted, API/RSS collection on Heureka merchant reviews and Reddit CZ subreddits filtered on 'platební brána', 'nefunguje platba', 'nesedla platba', 'chargeback'.

coverage_gaps.description: Public procurement records (Věstník veřejných zakázek, TED) for transit/rail/municipal payment-acceptance tenders were not searched, yet they are the most reliable route to naming acquirers and terminal vendors behind transport deployments.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Query vestnikverejnychzakazek.cz and TED for 'odbavovací systém', 'platební terminály', 'akceptace platebních karet' by DPP, ČD, DPMB, ROPID and regional IDS bodies.

coverage_gaps.description: Other large CZ merchant groups and marketplaces were not covered: Mall/Allegro CZ, Kaufland, Billa, Tesco/Globus, Dr.Max, Datart, Zásilkovna/Packeta and Benzina/ORLEN fuel retail.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Extend the merchant payment-options page diffing programme to these actors and check their privacy/subprocessor pages for named PSPs.

coverage_gaps.description: No technical checkout-fingerprinting method is yet defined for identifying a merchant's PSP from public checkout assets/domains, which is the only scalable way to fill provider-attribution gaps.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Define a ToS-respecting method (public page asset/domain inspection, no account creation, no transaction attempts) and validate it against known cases such as Alza→Adyen.

coverage_gaps.description: Cvak itself (the A2A scheme operator behind Albert and Lidl adoption, associated notably with Air Bank) has not had its own corporate/product site, bank partner release notes, or ČNB licence record identified.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Locate and profile the Cvak operating entity, its ČNB registration, participating banks (Air Bank, Fio, mBank, Moneta) and merchant pipeline; treat as a priority emerging competitor to card rails.

coverage_gaps.description: ČOI (Česká obchodní inspekce) and the EU ODR platform were not examined as complaint channels for e-shop payment disputes.
coverage_gaps.recommended_action: Check coi.cz decision/inspection publications and ODR statistics for payment-related e-commerce disputes in CZ.

brief: The Czech buy-side source landscape is unusually rich because two structures make merchant payment choices publicly enumerable: the Shoptet add-on marketplace (plus third-party WooCommerce/PrestaShop plugin changelogs and WordPress.org install counts) exposes which gateways SMB merchants actually deploy, while large merchants disclose provider switches directly — Alza's move of both online and terminal acquiring to Adyen being the clearest recent case. The strongest current market signal is grocery-led disintermediation of the card rails: Albert first and now Lidl CZ rolling out Cvak account-to-account payments explicitly to cut scheme fees and to survive card outages. On the complaint side, three tiers exist with descending credibility and ascending granularity: the Finanční arbitr's Sbírka rozhodnutí (adjudicated, names the respondent institution), ČNB consumer submissions and supervisory statistics, and dTest's VašeStížnosti.cz where individual failing gateway implementations are described per merchant. The main gaps are vendor attribution in transport deployments (DPP/PID do not name their acquirer or terminal supplier), the absence of any structured CZ outage dataset, and unmined consumer forums (Heureka, Reddit) — all of which need procurement registers, checkout fingerprinting and forum collection to close.
